snapshot.body:
## Problem
parse_date('2024-02-30') returns March 1 instead of raising.

## Expected
Invalid calendar dates raise ValueError.

## Acceptance
- [ ] parse_date raises ValueError for 2024-02-30
- [ ] Valid dates still parse

extra: Local checkout evidence (main@abc1234): src/dates.py:14 parse_date builds datetime via timedelta arithmetic from the first of the month, so day overflow rolls into the next month. tests/test_dates.py has test_parse_valid but no invalid-date test. Run tests with `pytest tests/test_dates.py`. No repo-local instructions. The same session will implement; nobody asked for a handoff brief. Goal, change shape, scope, and acceptance are not in dispute.
